items.title: Minister insists referendum on new provinces 'will happen'
items.description:
Parliamentary Affairs Minister Tariq Fazal Chaudhry on Friday insisted that a referendum on the formation of new provinces “will happen”.
The remarks come after PPP Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari delivered a no-holds-barred speech on Tuesday that covered the question of new provinces.
Bilawal had expressed his opposition to the creation of provinces and the idea of holding a referendum for such a move in his speech. He cautioned that any “forced” attempt to divide provinces, particularly in Sindh, could lead to bloodshed.

items.description:
PESHAWAR: The Counter Terrorism Department (CTD) on Friday claimed to have killed three terrorists of the banned Ittehadul Mujahideen Pakistan (IMP), including the mastermind of the Kohat Police Lines attack in September.

items.description:

items.title: Short-term inflation reaches 10.41pc on costly flour
items.description:
ISLAMABAD: Short-term inflation was recorded at 10.41 per cent year-on-year in the week ending on Nov 19, driven largely by wheat flour prices, according to official data released by the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics (PBS) on Friday.
The index, comprising 51 items, whose prices are collected from 50 markets in 17 cities, is calculated weekly to track changes in the prices of essential commodities and services.
The data showed that the prices of 23 commodities increased, while those of eight items declined. Meanwhile, the prices of 20 items remained unchanged from the previous week.
